decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Reason for Refusal

1.	The proposed single storey side extension, by lack of a front building line setback, represents an inappropriate design that would not be secondary in appearance to the subject dwelling and would be uncharacteristic with the established pattern of development in the immediate locality and is therefore contrary with Adopted UDP policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.4.1 (Housing standards and Guidelines) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003; and Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.

2.	The proposed single storey side extension would result in the loss of the existing on-site parking space leading to increased congestion, which would be detrimental to the free and safe flow of traffic and is therefore contrary with Adopted UDP policy T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003.

3.	The proposed single storey side extension would result in the loss of the landscaped amenity space to the front of the side projection, which was specifically required by condition 4 of planning application 01528/1/P1 granted on the 26th January 1988 by the London Borough of Hounslow for a garage conversion at 1 Lindsay Gardens, Bedfont.
description: Erection of single storey side extension to dwellinghouse.
